lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid; density is highest immediately posterior to the gill slits with smaller diameters, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands to form a grid; high-luminance blobs are positioned as anchor nodes within the center of the grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
